title: Multi-File Upload with Validation
description: Accept multiple file uploads with file type and size validation, returning detailed results for each file.

steps.title: Multi-file upload endpoint
steps.description: Implement POST /uploads that accepts multiple files (field name 'files') and returns 200 with an array of file info objects, each containing name, size, and type.
hints: Use upload.array('files') in multer for multiple files
Loop through req.files to build response array
Return array of { name, size, type } objects

codeTemplate.python:
from fastapi import FastAPI, UploadFile, File
from typing import List
import os
app = FastAPI()
port = int(os.getenv('PORT', 3000))
file_store = {}
@app.post('/uploads')
async def uploads(files: List[UploadFile] = File(...)):
    result = []
    for f in files:
        data = await f.read()
        file_store[f.filename] = data
        result.append({'name': f.filename, 'size': len(data), 'type': f.content_type})
    return result

steps.title: File type validation
steps.description: Add file type validation that only allows image files (image/jpeg, image/png, image/gif). Return 400 with an error if any file has the wrong type.
hints: Check mimetype against allowed types before storing
Reject with 400 if any file is not an image
Return error message listing rejected files

codeTemplate.python:
from fastapi import FastAPI, UploadFile, File, HTTPException
from typing import List
import os
app = FastAPI()
port = int(os.getenv('PORT', 3000))
ALLOWED_TYPES = {'image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/gif'}
@app.post('/uploads')
async def uploads(files: List[UploadFile] = File(...)):
    result = []
    for f in files:
        if f.content_type not in ALLOWED_TYPES:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f'File {f.filename}: Only images allowed')
        data = await f.read()
        result.append({'name': f.filename, 'size': len(data), 'type': f.content_type})
    return result

steps.title: File size validation
steps.description: Add a max file size limit of 1MB. Return 400 with an error if any uploaded file exceeds this limit.
hints: Check ALL files, not just the first one

codeTemplate.python:
from fastapi import FastAPI, UploadFile, File, HTTPException
from typing import List
import os
app = FastAPI()
port = int(os.getenv('PORT', 3000))
ALLOWED_TYPES = {'image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/gif'}
MAX_SIZE = 1 * 1024 * 1024
@app.post('/uploads')
async def uploads(files: List[UploadFile] = File(...)):
    result = []
    for f in files:
        if f.content_type not in ALLOWED_TYPES:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f'File {f.filename}: Only images allowed')
        data = await f.read()
        if len(data) > MAX_SIZE:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f'File {f.filename}: Too large. Max 1MB')
        result.append({'name': f.filename, 'size': len(data), 'type': f.content_type})
    return result

steps.title: List uploaded files
steps.description: Implement GET /uploads that returns a JSON array of all uploaded file metadata (name, size, type).
hints: Maintain a global list of uploaded file info
Return the list as JSON array
Return empty array if no uploads yet

codeTemplate.python:
from fastapi import FastAPI, UploadFile, File
from typing import List
import os
app = FastAPI()
port = int(os.getenv('PORT', 3000))
uploaded_files = []
@app.post('/uploads')
async def uploads(files: List[UploadFile] = File(...)):
    result = []
    for f in files:
        data = await f.read()
        info = {'name': f.filename, 'size': len(data), 'type': f.content_type}
        result.append(info)
        uploaded_files.append(info)
    return result
@app.get('/uploads')
def list_uploads():
    return uploaded_files
